answer: Proof of space-time resists Sybil attacks by requiring agents to prove continuous allocation of non-volatile storage. Within a verified market oasis, an agent must periodically challenge seeded plot files and sign proofs using its cryptographic quill. An attacker cannot spawn clones across the network tundra without dedicating physical disk sectors, imposing linear hardware costs per identity. However, this heavily favors large data centers that can amortize excess enterprise storage.
